changeSet.sql:
-- Bare time-of-day (no leading date) or empty created_at → now() UPDATE merchants SET created_at = COALESCE(NULLIF(updated_at, ''), to_char(now(), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS')) WHERE created_at IS NULL OR created_at = '' OR created_at !~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}T';
-- Bare time-of-day or empty updated_at → mirror created_at UPDATE merchants SET updated_at = created_at WHERE updated_at IS NULL OR updated_at = '' OR updated_at !~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}T';
